1.web: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
1.asv: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger, Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

2.web: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
2.asv: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; for I am withered away: O Jehovah, heal me; for my bones are troubled.

3.web: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?
3.asv: My soul also is sore troubled: And thou, O Jehovah, how long?

4.web: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
4.asv: Return, O Jehovah, deliver my soul: Save me for thy lovingkindness’ sake.

5.web: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
5.asv: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: In Sheol who shall give thee thanks?

6.web: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
6.asv: I am weary with my groaning; Every night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

7.web: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
7.asv: Mine eye wasteth away because of grief; It waxeth old because of all mine adversaries.

8.web: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.
8.asv: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.

9.web: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.
9.asv: Jehovah hath heard my supplication; Jehovah will receive my prayer.

10.web: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
10.asv: All mine enemies shall be put to shame and sore troubled: They shall turn back, they shall be put to shame suddenly.
